SELECT * FROM (WITH categories AS (
         SELECT v_sales_items.category_label,
            count(*) AS item_count,
            count(DISTINCT v_sales_items.order_id) AS order_count,
            sum(v_sales_items.price) AS product_sales
           FROM reporting.v_sales_items
          WHERE v_sales_items.in_sales_scope
          GROUP BY v_sales_items.category_label
        ), ranked AS (
         SELECT c.category_label,
            c.item_count,
            c.order_count,
            c.product_sales,
            row_number() OVER w AS sales_rank,
            sum(c.product_sales) OVER (ORDER BY c.product_sales DESC, c.category_label ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_sales,
            sum(c.product_sales) OVER () AS total_sales
           FROM categories c
          WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY c.product_sales DESC, c.category_label)
        )
 SELECT sales_rank::integer AS sales_rank,
    category_label,
    item_count,
    order_count,
    product_sales::numeric(14,2) AS product_sales,
    round(product_sales / NULLIF(total_sales, 0::numeric), 4) AS sales_share,
    cumulative_sales::numeric(14,2) AS cumulative_sales,
    round(cumulative_sales / NULLIF(total_sales, 0::numeric), 4) AS cumulative_share
   FROM ranked) q ORDER BY sales_rank
SELECT * FROM reporting.mv_category_sales ORDER BY sales_rank
